mapper.select: WITH sys_code AS ( SELECT a.* FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code a ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'IcsComplianceType' AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(b.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code b WHERE b.sys09_code_kind_id = a.sys09_code_kind_id AND b.sys09_company_id = a.sys09_company_id AND b.sys09_code = a.sys09_code AND b.sys09_apply_date <= #{stdDate} ) AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'1900-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') != 'true' ) ) ), nonReason AS ( SELECT ' - ' || STRING_AGG(COALESCE(ics31_reason, ''), ' ' ORDER BY ics30_sub_num) AS reason , ics30_compliance_type AS compliance_type FROM ics31_compliance_write INNER JOIN ics30_compliance ON ics30_compliance_id = ics31_compliance_id WHERE ics31_person_id = #{personId} AND ics31_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics31_yyyymm = TO_CHAR(#{stdDate}::date,'YYYY.MM') AND ics31_cycle_type = #{cycleType} GROUP BY ics30_compliance_type ) SELECT sys09_name AS compliance_type_name , f_get_compliance_result(#{personId}, #{stdDate}, #{cycleType}, ics30_compliance_type, ics30_start_date) AS compliance_result , reason AS reason FROM ics30_compliance a INNER JOIN sys_code ON sys09_code = ics30_compliance_type LEFT OUTER JOIN nonReason ON compliance_type = ics30_compliance_type WHERE ics30_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics30_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(ics30_start_date) FROM ics30_compliance WHERE ics30_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics30_start_date <= #{stdDate} AND COALESCE(ics30_date_fix_yn,'false') = 'true' ) AND ( ( ics30_use_yn = 'false' AND ics30_use_close_date >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( ics30_use_yn != 'false' ) ) GROUP BY ics30_compliance_type, ics30_start_date, sys09_code, sys09_name, sys09_seq, reason ORDER BY LPAD(sys09_seq,5,'0')
